title: equisetum ramosissimum var. scabrum
intro: Equisetum ramosissimum var. scabrum, commonly known as Chinese horsetail, is a type of perennial plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to help with kidney and urinary system issues, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum ramosissimum var. scabrum include diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to remove excess fluids from the body, relieve respiratory problems, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
